name: Microgrid storage power-converter ready interface
summary: Identifies the converter readiness information used before accepting a dispatch request.
description: Identifies the converter readiness information used before accepting a dispatch request. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Converter health and readiness” at the input and “Storage converter available” at the output. Battery readiness is a separate dependency.
